{{Quote|The Rachuk sector is immaterial at the moment, except as a symbol and a wound the Empire must stanch. We want this raid to go off in twelve hours.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="X-wing" />}}
The '''Rachuk sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==Description==
[[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Chorax]], [[Hensara III]] and [[Vladet]], the sector capital. It was located [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] of [[Morobe sector/Legends|Morobe sector]].<ref name="X-wing" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Admiral, despite this mis-judgment, is formidable enough that I should think the Rebels utter fools to operate in his command sector.|[[Kirtan Loor]], about [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Devlia]]|<ref name="X-wing" />}}
In the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the sector was defended by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Raschuk Sector Fleet|Sector Fleet]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Devlia]] from Vladet.<ref name="X-wing" />

It was the site of the first missions of reformed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilots during the push to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] abandoned this strategy after the Republic [[Talasea's Planetary Governor's Palace|base]] on [[Talasea]] was [[Raid on Talasea|discovered]] by the Empire. The New Republic eventually penetrated the Core Worlds through the [[Pyria system]].<ref name="X-wing" />
